evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: A fact check rated as false the claim that China was the first country to land on the moon's South Pole a few years ago, contradicting the idea that India was not the first.

outputs.notes_en: The provided fact checks primarily address misinformation related to visuals, animations, and other aspects surrounding the Chandrayaan-3 mission, rather than directly confirming or refuting the core claims about India's landing achievements. Only one fact check directly relates to the claim of India being the first to land on the lunar south pole by refuting a claim that China was first.
